scope: Post hoc exact-QM global-multipole hierarchy reconstructed only from the already-computed ten-solute confirmatory base response densities and coupled only to the already-computed frozen isolated-water probe densities.

physical_charge_convention.stored_response_density_matrix: positive electron-number density matrix D_resp = D_full - D_solute_ghost - D_waters_ghost
physical_charge_convention.multipole_charge_density: physical electronic response charge density rho_resp_charge(r) = -rho_resp_electron_number(r); nuclei cancel exactly
physical_charge_convention.raw_moment: M^(n)_{i1...in}(O) = integral rho_resp_charge(r) product_k (r_ik-O_ik) dr in atomic units
physical_charge_convention.traceless_octupole: O_ijk = 5 M^(3)_ijk - delta_ij T_k - delta_ik T_j - delta_jk T_i, where T_i = sum_a M^(3)_iaa
physical_charge_convention.potential: V(R)=q/R + p_i R_i/R^3 + Q_ij R_i R_j/(2 R^5) + O_ijk R_i R_j R_k/(2 R^7) + ...
physical_charge_convention.probe_coupling: E=q Phi_W(O) + p_i d_i Phi_W(O) + Q_ij d_ij Phi_W(O)/6 + O_ijk d_ijk Phi_W(O)/30, using the complete frozen isolated-water QM electrostatic potential Phi_W
physical_charge_convention.units: q in e, p in e bohr, Q in e bohr^2, O in e bohr^3; energies in Hartree then kcal/mol

origin_reporting_rule.W4_energy: For each hierarchy order, the displayed conservative control is the single panel-wide origin with the lowest equal-solute W4 energy MAE.
origin_reporting_rule.W4_torque: For each hierarchy order, the displayed conservative control is the single panel-wide origin with the lowest W4 torque vector RMSE.
origin_reporting_rule.W4_orientation: For each hierarchy order, the displayed conservative control is the single panel-wide origin with the lowest mean absolute-profile RMSE; the same selected origin is used for the secondary mean-centred profile metric.
origin_reporting_rule.W4_W12_energy: For each hierarchy order, use the origin selected once by the primary W4 energy endpoint; do not reselect by rank or distance.

numerics.moments: analytic PySCF AO overlap, r, rr and rrr integrals about each origin; no real-space fitting
numerics.dipole_coupling: the existing exact-dipole evaluator and its two-point central gradient step of 1e-4 bohr, retained to reproduce the published baseline exactly
numerics.quadrupole_and_octupole_coupling: second and third derivatives of the complete frozen-water QM ESP at the expansion origin from tensor-product seven-point central finite differences
numerics.validation_case_rule: fewest and most base atoms, chosen from numerical cost before hierarchy outcomes
numerics.orientation_grid: unchanged 24 proper octahedral rotations with W4 oxygen fixed

validation.order1_reproduction: Maximum absolute difference from every existing exact-dipole energy used here must be <=1e-10 kcal/mol because the same dipole coupling function is called.
validation.charge_and_dipole_sign: -Tr[D_resp S] must give physical response charge and -Tr[D_resp r] must reproduce the stored physical response dipole.
validation.origin_translation: Direct AO moments at all three origins must agree with exact raw-moment translation formulas through rank 3.
validation.rotation_covariance: For the existing independently recomputed rotated methane response density, p'=Rp, Q'=RQR^T and O'_{ijk}=R_ia R_jb R_kc O_abc are checked at the correspondingly rotated origin.
validation.derivative_convergence: Report hierarchy energy changes between the primary and both check steps for the two validation cases; no step is changed after comparative outcomes.
validation.rigid_probe_reuse: Use the existing converged torque and orientation variant density matrices without recomputation.
validation.complete_accounting: All ten W4 cases, all 60 W4 torque variants, all 240 W4 orientations and all 90 initial W4-W12 probes are required.

source_extent_diagnostic.purpose: Diagnose whether a finite-order global expansion is evaluated outside a practically enclosing source radius; never assume convergence.
source_extent_diagnostic.density_grid: PySCF Becke grid level 4 on the base molecule
additional_geometry: maximum base-nuclear radius from each origin
oxygen and minimum probe-nuclear distance from each origin
probe distance divided by r90/r95/r99 and by maximum base-nuclear radius
source_extent_diagnostic.interpretation: Gaussian basis densities have noncompact tails. A probe inside these practical source extents means the low-order hierarchy is a near-field truncation test, not a convergent exterior multipole expansion test.

secondary: W4-W12 response-coupling energy by rank and distance

statistics.comparisons: GLIDER minus MACE-POLAR-1-L and GLIDER minus each selected hierarchy control
statistics.wins: fraction of solutes with lower error

interpretation_boundary.allowed_if_higher_moments_close_gap: The learned spatial response retains information representable in principle by higher global moments while predicting it directly from geometry without requiring QM multipoles.
interpretation_boundary.allowed_if_gap_remains: The tested low-order global multipole truncations do not recover all finite-distance response information in these configurations.
forbidden_claims: the full spatial field is uniquely necessary
higher-order or distributed multipoles are ruled out
this is a complete interaction energy, Hamiltonian, force field, dynamics method or thermodynamic observable

change_control: Immutable after the protocol-freeze commit. A numerical bug requires a dated amendment retaining the original rule, corrected rule, reason and affected outputs.
